notes.title: - Patch Notes (Version 1.0.9) -
notes.content:
--New Additions--

A "Game Brightness" button has been added to the title screen menu and in the game menu. Changing brightness to high will increase the overall level of brightness on certain maps that appeared too dark when the game was run on certain hardware. In addition, all maps have been given a base increase in level brightness.

If the player quits the game while on the title screen, there is now a confirmation box that will ask the player to confirm yes or no to whether they really want to quit the game.

The Time Challenges on all levels aside from Arcade have been increased for easier completion times.

Gun Cat's sprite has been changed to match his modern design.


--Bug Fixes--

Fixed a few spelling errors in dialogue and text.

Fixed a few miscellaneous bugs


--Adjusted the game balance--

+Adjusted the spawn locations for one of the Water Bottles on Hard Maze. This Water Bottle will always spawn near the player at the start of the map.

+Increased the players' stamina regeneration rate for level 1 & 2 stamina. LVL 1 (3.0 -> 4.0) / LVL 2 (6.0 -> 7.0)

+Wally The Seal has received an overall decrease in speed when he becomes enraged on a hard difficulty map.

+The amount of neglect Mrs. Wally gains per second when not looking at her on hard difficulty maps has been decreased. (100 -> 80)

+Molly The Seal will now have one less spawn on normal difficulty maps and two less spawns on hard difficulty maps. ND (9 -> 8) / HD (15 -> 13)


--Dev Notes--

I will continue to adjust and fix any issues encountered with Wally The Seal 2. Any and all feedback is appreciated and thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: - Patch Notes (Version 1.0.8) -
notes.content:
--Bug Fixes--

Adjusted support for Linux/Steam Deck, the game should run without needing to select a proton now.

Fixed shadow issues on the Title Screen Map


--Dev Notes--

Sorry to steam users if this update broke save data! This is all new to me, and I'm trying my best to figure out Steam and its systems. Currently, I am working on cloud support for the game and, hopefully, I can get that done soon. As always, thank you so much for your continued support!
